# Architecture

Style: Modular monolith, layered.

## Layers

- **Backend**: API -> service, commons; Service -> repository, integration, commons; Integration -> service, commons; Repository -> service, commons; Commons -> nothing
- **Frontend**: Views -> state; State -> api; API client -> nothing
- **Socket filter**: Filter -> nothing

Principles, in order: make-it-work, yagni, least-surprise, kiss, consistent, dry, clean-code, solid.
Patterns: ports-and-adapters, repository, adapter.

## Components

### Backend
#### Tasks engine
- API: [Tasks API](components/api-tasks.md): REST and SSE routes for tasks, sessions and the task event stream.
- Service: [Task engine service](components/engine-service.md): Task lifecycle: start, poll, wake, events, cost; owns the TaskLauncher and BridgeClient interfaces.
- Integration: [Task engine integration](components/engine-integration.md): Docker and local launchers and the HTTP/WebSocket bridge client.
- Repository: [Task record repository](components/engine-repository.md): One mode-600 JSON file per task in ENGINE_DATA_DIR.
#### Backlog
- API: [Backlog API](components/api-backlog.md): REST routes under /api/backlog and the backlog error filter.
- Service: [Backlog service](components/backlog-service.md): Lanes, items and moves over a BacklogConnector; emits trigger events for moves.
- Integration: [Backlog connectors](components/backlog-integration.md): GitLab connector and the in-memory test connector.
- Repository: [Backlog cache repository](components/backlog-repository.md): The single backlog.json cache file.
#### Workflows
- API: [Workflows API](components/api-workflows.md): Routes for workflow definitions, runs and generations, with their DTOs and error filter.
- Service: [Workflow service](components/workflow-service.md): Workflow definitions, the runner that follows task changes, runs, plain-task runs and the generator.
- Integration: [Workflow adapters](components/workflow-integration.md): EngineWorkflowTasks and BacklogWorkItems adapters and the workflow integration module.
- Repository: [Workflow file repositories](components/workflow-repository.md): YAML definitions, run JSON and generation files.
#### Schedules
- API: [Schedules API](components/api-schedules.md): Routes under /api/schedules and the schedule error filter.
- Service: [Schedule service](components/schedule-service.md): Schedules, the ticking runner and run results; owns ScheduledTasks and the repository interfaces.
- Integration: [Schedule adapter](components/schedule-integration.md): EngineScheduledTasks adapter and its module.
- Repository: [Schedule file repository](components/schedule-repository.md): One mode-600 JSON per schedule with its last 50 results.
#### Architecture
- API: [Architecture API](components/api-architecture.md): Read-only routes for the architecture page and the architecture error filter.
- Service: [Architecture service](components/architecture-service.md): Reads and validates docs/architecture files of configured repositories through RepositoryFiles.
- Integration: [Architecture git access](components/architecture-integration.md): Partial bare clones read with ls-tree and cat-file.
#### System and repositories
- API: [System and repositories API](components/api-system.md): Health, system info and repository list routes.
- Service: [System and repositories service](components/system-service.md): System info and the configured repository list.
- Repository: [Package info repository](components/system-repository.md): Reads package.json for system info.
#### Across modules
- Commons: [Backend commons](components/backend-commons.md): Generic config, global pipes, filters and interceptors, shared input rules.

### Frontend
- Views: [Frontend views](components/frontend-views.md): React components, one CSS module each, and the page shells that wire them.
- State: [Frontend state](components/frontend-state.md): Hooks that load, stream and mutate through the API client.
- API client: [Frontend API client](components/frontend-api.md): The only code that calls the backend: fetch, SSE and typed models.

### Socket filter
- Filter: [Docker socket filter](components/socket-filter.md): A Unix-socket HTTP proxy that allows only what DockerTaskLauncher sends, only for task containers.
